import ctypes

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# int gsl_ieee_set_mode(int precision, int rounding, int exception_mask)
gsl.gsl_ieee_set_mode.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int]
gsl.gsl_ieee_set_mode.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Constants for precision
GSL_IEEE_SINGLE_PRECISION = 0
GSL_IEEE_DOUBLE_PRECISION = 1
GSL_IEEE_EXTENDED_PRECISION = 2

# Constants for rounding
GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_NEAREST = 0
GSL_IEEE_ROUND_DOWN = 1
GSL_IEEE_ROUND_UP = 2
GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_ZERO = 3

# Constants for exception mask
GSL_IEEE_MASK_INVALID = 1
GSL_IEEE_MASK_DENORMALIZED = 2
GSL_IEEE_MASK_DIVISION_BY_ZERO = 4
GSL_IEEE_MASK_OVERFLOW = 8
GSL_IEEE_MASK_UNDERFLOW = 16
GSL_IEEE_TRAP_INEXACT = 32

# Function to set IEEE mode
def set_ieee_mode(precision, rounding, exception_mask):
    return gsl.gsl_ieee_set_mode(precision, rounding, exception_mask)

# Assertion tests
def assert_test():
    # Test with single precision, round to nearest, no exception mask
    assert set_ieee_mode(GSL_IEEE_SINGLE_PRECISION, GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_NEAREST, 0) == 0
    # Test with double precision, round down, mask invalid
    assert set_ieee_mode(GSL_IEEE_DOUBLE_PRECISION, GSL_IEEE_ROUND_DOWN, GSL_IEEE_MASK_INVALID) == 0
    # Test with extended precision, round up, mask division by zero
    assert set_ieee_mode(GSL_IEEE_EXTENDED_PRECISION, GSL_IEEE_ROUND_UP, GSL_IEEE_MASK_DIVISION_BY_ZERO) == 0
    # Test with invalid precision, should default to extended precision
    assert set_ieee_mode(99, GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_ZERO, GSL_IEEE_MASK_OVERFLOW) == 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert_test()
